findings.evidence: Spec 3.3 says an offline register fetches nothing, but the text input converts on blur or Enter without an isOffline() check, so a typed URL is fetched (directly, then through wsrv.nl) while offline; only register is guarded.
findings.impact: Offline users see a fetch error instead of the offline message when they leave the URL field; no data is written.
findings.recommendation: Skip blur/Enter conversion of text sources while offline (or show OFFLINE_WRITE_MESSAGE).

findings.evidence: runIconWrite still sets the page-level iconError when an icon upsert fails inside the shared dialog; the editor hides it only while the dialog is open, so after the user cancels the dialog the same error reappears under the classification icon section.
findings.impact: A stale error stays visible in the template editor after the user gave up on that icon.
findings.recommendation: Clear iconError when the dialog closes, or stop setting it from the dialog path and return the text only.

findings.evidence: The dialog hint and the site descriptions use the docs itemized style ('권장함', '변환해 저장함', '저장할 때 반영됨'), while the app's user-facing copy elsewhere is polite sentence style ('...했습니다'). The style was inherited from the R77 dialog.
findings.impact: Inconsistent tone in user-facing UI text.
findings.recommendation: Decide the UI copy style for dialogs and align the shared dialog and site descriptions in one pass.
